name: Complete Template Control + CA Publishing
description: Principal has complete control over a template and can publish it

esc5.description: Ability to publish templates to CA

prerequisites: Target certificate template is NOT currently published/enabled on any Certificate Authority
Principal has complete control (GenericAll/Owner) over the unpublished template
Principal has ESC5 rights to publish templates to Certificate Authority
Certificate Authority is accessible for template publication and enrollment
steps: Identify vulnerable certificate template with GenericAll/Owner permissions
Modify template to disable manager approval (msPKI-Enrollment-Flag)
Publish modified template to Certificate Authority
Enroll malicious certificate with domain admin SAN
